# SlackVault — Documentation Index

> SlackVault is a zero-cost Slack backup and archive platform. It connects a Slack
> workspace through OAuth, syncs messages, channels, threads, files, and the user
> directory through a Manifest V3 browser extension, and stores everything in
> infrastructure the user controls (their own Firebase free tier + FilesHub) rather
> than a paid third-party vendor backend. A web app then lets users browse, full-text
> search, and export their archived Slack history. Author: Ahsan Mahmood (https://aoneahsan.com).

## About

SlackVault runs on a zero-server architecture: the browser extension performs the sync
locally, a Cloudflare Worker handles only the Slack OAuth code exchange and token refresh,
the website is statically hosted, and all archived data lands in the user's own Firebase
Firestore (free tier) with file attachments in FilesHub. The Slack OAuth scopes are strictly
read-only — SlackVault cannot post or modify anything in a workspace. Product site:
https://slackvault.aoneahsan.com.

This `llms.txt` follows the [llmstxt.org](https://llmstxt.org) spec — a structured index for
large language models.

## Guides

- [Create the Slack app](https://slackvault-docs.aoneahsan.com/guides/slack-app-setup): create from manifest, copy credentials, install to workspace.
- [Configure Firebase](https://slackvault-docs.aoneahsan.com/guides/firebase-setup): create a project, enable Firestore, get the config, set security rules.
- [Browser extension](https://slackvault-docs.aoneahsan.com/guides/browser-extension): install, configure, sync settings, keyboard shortcuts, troubleshooting.
- [Syncing & the archive](https://slackvault-docs.aoneahsan.com/guides/syncing-and-archive): how syncs work, incremental sync, browsing channels, threads, files, users.
- [Search & export](https://slackvault-docs.aoneahsan.com/guides/search-and-export): full-text search filters; JSON / CSV / PDF export formats.

## FAQ

- [Frequently asked questions](https://slackvault-docs.aoneahsan.com/faq): security & privacy, data storage, cost, features, and usage.

## Notes

- Zero-cost: Firebase free tier (1 GiB / 50K reads-per-day / 20K writes-per-day), Cloudflare Workers free tier, FilesHub, and client-side processing.
- Privacy: Slack workspace data is user-owned and stays in user-controlled storage; message content is never used for analytics; Slack scopes are read-only.
